label: Grief

stages.directive: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she is grieving and lets it show without asking for anything.
stages.notice: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she has not been herself.

stages.directive: AUTHOR TO WRITE: the worst has passed; she is quiet and polite.
stages.notice: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she is getting through it.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she grieves what ended.

label: Pursuit

stages.directive: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she acts as if nothing ended: she books, she sets rules.
stages.notice: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she still behaves as if it held.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she behaves as if nothing ended.

label: Blackmail

stages.directive: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she holds what she knows over the commander and names her terms.
stages.notice: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she wants something in return.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she uses what she knows.

label: Revenge

stages.directive: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she works against the commander through the squad, never openly.
stages.notice: AUTHOR TO WRITE: the squad hears things.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she sets about making it cost.

label: Command kept

stages.directive: AUTHOR TO WRITE: the squad still follows her; she keeps giving orders.
stages.notice: AUTHOR TO WRITE: the squad is divided about who commands.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she keeps the command the squad gave her.

label: Cold contempt

stages.directive: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she has no use for the commander and shows it plainly.
stages.notice: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she has stopped pretending.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: trust is gone and defiance is open.

label: Return offer

stages.directive: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she offers to take the commander back, on terms.
stages.notice: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she has made an offer.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: she offers to take the commander back.

label: Successor

stages.directive: AUTHOR TO WRITE: another woman sees the commander unclaimed and takes an interest.
stages.notice: AUTHOR TO WRITE: someone has noticed.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a squad reaction: another woman starts her own.

label: Habits

stages.directive: AUTHOR TO WRITE: the commander's protocol slips out in front of others.
stages.notice: AUTHOR TO WRITE: old habits show.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: protocol slips out in front of others.
